name: Eleni Papageorgiou
bio:
Eleni's motorsport journey began unconventionally, not with a childhood spent karting, but with a fascination for optimizing complex systems. While studying supply chain management in Thessaloniki, she became captivated by the intricate logistics of a Formula 1 race she watched on television. This spark led her to pursue internships in motorsport logistics, eventually landing a role with a smaller European racing team. After several seasons honing her skills, an opportunity with Brad Jones Racing drew her to Australia.

Eleni is meticulous and data-driven in her approach to logistics. She prides herself on anticipating potential problems before they arise, ensuring the team has the right resources at the right place and time. Her colleagues appreciate her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to find creative solutions to logistical challenges. She is known for her innovative use of technology to streamline operations, and her dedication to continuous improvement has earned her respect within the team.

What sets Eleni apart is her relentless pursuit of efficiency and her innate ability to manage resources optimally. She sees logistics not just as a support function, but as a competitive advantage, and her contributions consistently help the team perform at its best.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eleni is of average height with a lean build, and typically wears practical attire suitable for working in the pit lane.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with logistical diagrams and flowcharts.
Has a habit of color-coding everything related to logistics, from inventory tags to travel itineraries.
Insists on double-checking all shipments and deliveries, even when time is tight.
